searchText: In state tests, is coinbase balance increased due to transaction processing? The transactions in state tests have "gas price" only. Does it mean they work like legacy transactions if EIP-1559 is considered? It is not documented how `BLOCKHASH` works in state tests. Do I remember we should use some pre-defined sequence of hashes? Blockhash returns keccak(blocknumber) for -256-current blocknumber to currentbn, 0 otherwise afair
